blocks.text: SAN ANTONIO— Victor Wembanyama had 32 points and 11 rebounds, Stephon Castle added 21 points and 12 assists, and the San Antonio Spurs held off the Los Angeles Clippers for a 124-112 victory in the NBA on Thursday night. Julian Champagnie added 20 points for San Antonio, which bounced back from a 105-93 loss to Detroit on Tuesday that snapped its 12-game winning streak. Wembanyama was 13 for 26 in scoring at least 30 points for the seventh time this season. Darius Garland and Brook Lopez had 23 points apiece for Los Angeles.
